_doc: Time-limited offers shown by promotions.py. Only add an offer you have checked at its source. A coupon_code is shown only when code_verified is true. countdown_prefix (e.g. At most) goes before the time left when the offer can end early. ends_at is the first moment the offer no longer applies, with its UTC offset; precision 'day' means the source gives a date, not a time. An offer whose verification is older than recheck_days, or whose ends_at has passed, is taken off every page at the next build, and gy-reveal.js hides it in the reader's browser the moment it ends.

promotions.title: Half off Fukuoka stays until 15 December
promotions.benefit: Fukuoka Prefecture pays 50% of a stay in the prefecture, up to ¥20,000 a person a trip for a room alone, ¥30,000 for two nights or more with transport.
eligibility: Overseas visitors are eligible; business trips and day use are not
Book through a registered hotel directly, a registered Fukuoka travel agency or a listed site such as Rakuten Travel, Jalan or Ikyu.com
Booking.com is not on the list
promotions.how_to_claim: Book through a participating channel; the lead guest signs a usage certificate on the day.
promotions.end_text: Stays to 15 December 2026, checkout by 16 December

verification.evidence: Campaign site on 19 October 2026: stay period 1 October to 15 December 2026, checkout by 16 December; the 'campaign has ended' banner is not switched on (checked outside HTML comments); it ends early once the budget is reached.

promotions.title: Half-price public transport in Victoria
promotions.benefit: Trains, trams and buses across Victoria are half price for everyone: the full-fare daily cap is $5.70 instead of $11.40.
eligibility: Everyone, visitors included, paying by myki or a contactless bank card
Not SkyBus, ferries or non-subsidised regional buses
promotions.how_to_claim: Nothing to do: the lower fare is charged automatically.

verification.evidence: vic.gov.au on 15 October 2026: half price from 1 June 2026 until 1 January 2027; excludes SkyBus, ferries and non-subsidised regional buses. It does not say whether 1 January is included, so the countdown ends at its start.
